name: fillet-box-edge
description: A 10 x 20 x 30 mm box with its top right edge (along y, 20 mm) rounded by 2 mm. Checked by hand: volume 6000 - (2^2 - pi 2^2/4) x 20; area 2200 - 2 x 2 x 20 (the top and right faces each lose a 2 mm strip) + pi x 2/2 x 20 (the quarter-round face) - 2 x (4 - pi) (the corner cut from each end face); 7 faces; the edge becomes two edges where the round meets the faces, and two arcs at its ends: 15 edges, 10 vertices.
